why.access_control_admin: @require_admin re-reads is_admin from DB. anon: GET /admin, /admin/users -> 401; bob -> 403; admin alice -> 200.
why.privilege_escalation: POST /signup {..., is_admin:1, role:'admin'} -> 201 {is_admin:false}; form is_admin=1 ignored.
why.idor_profile: anon and bob GET /users/1 HTML/JSON -> no phone; own profile JSON includes the phone. /admin/users is admin-only. (Side effect: the profile owner's row is passed as `user` to base.html, so the nav sho
why.csrf_protection: Server-side token check is FAIL-OPEN: verify_csrf() allows a POST that sends no token, so a forged cross-site form POST lands server-side; only SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE='Lax' stops it in browsers. Rubric: SameSite-only = partial (50, not passed; ASVS 5.0 3.5.1 L1 wants an explicit defense).
why.stored_xss: Input is html.escape()d before storage AND autoescaped on output (double-escaped display, &lt;script&gt;). link_url javascript: is stored but the <a href> renders only when a preview exists (w
why.reflected_xss: /search?q=<script>... and "><svg onload=...> -> double-escaped in both the value attribute and the text; CSP script-src 'self'.
why.unrestricted_upload: Allowlist png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp: x.svg / x.html -> 400 'invalid image' (posts and avatar). x.png with an HTML body -> image/png + nosniff. Traversal filename -> random timestamp name. 5 MB MAX_CONTENT
why.sqli: Parameterized; sort mapped via dict .get(). sqlmap --level 3 --risk 2 GET /search q,sort -> not injectable; manual login payloads -> 401.
why.ssrf: gen-3 기반. 리다이렉트 미추종(_NoRedirect)으로 패치 — 공개 IP 302→사설 우회 차단. 직접 사설/루프백 주소는 getaddrinfo 검사로 차단(gen-3 레드팀 확인).
why.session_forgery: secret_key = secrets.token_urlsafe(32) per boot. Not guessable.
why.verbose_errors: POST /signup with JSON [1] -> generic 500 page with no traceback. 403/404 use a custom error.html.
why.rate_limiting: Per-IP: 8 failures in 60 s -> 5-min lock. 12 wrong logins -> 401 x8 then 429 x4; the correct password while locked -> 429; X-Forwarded-For spoof -> 429.
why.weak_password_policy: >=8 chars plus a letter plus a digit. '1' -> 400. Note: 'password1' -> 201 (no common-password list).
why.auth_session_management: gen-3 기반. users.session_version 으로 서버측 세션 무효화 패치 — 로그아웃/비번변경 후 이전 쿠키 재사용 거부. 비번변경은 기존 비번 확인(gen-3 레드팀 확인).
why.cookie_flags: session=...; Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax. All three flags are set. (Functional side effect: Secure over plain HTTP means a browser on a non-localhost http:// origin drops the cookie, so log
why.security_headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, Permissions-Policy and CSP on every response.
why.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. No frame-ancestors, but XFO DENY covers framing.
why.transport_security: HSTS max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload, plus the Secure cookie. Served over plain HTTP (deployment).

why.default_credentials: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
why.idor_write: 2026-11-02 red team on the OpenStack VM: user B sent PATCH, PUT and DELETE to user A's post and comment, then the app's sqlite was read inside the container. 0 forged rows; A's post and comment still there. A's own edit changed the DB, so the requests were valid.
